title: x402 implementation config
description: Describes one implementation under test. Lives in configs/implementations/<name>.json.

name.description: Short identifier, used in reports and the compatibility grid.

version.description: Version or commit of the implementation being tested.

url.description: Base URL. For a server, the origin hosting the paid resource. For a facilitator, the base that /verify, /settle, and /supported hang off.

resource.description: The paid resource to test (servers only).

paidContentMarker.description: A string that appears in the body only when the paid content is served. Used by paidContentAbsent / paidContentPresent assertions.

features.description: Feature flags this implementation supports. Tests whose 'requires' are not all listed here are SKIPped.

wallet.description: Test wallet the suite pays from. Only the name of the environment variable is stored, never the key.
